description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_EnumToCSS that transforms HTML attribute values (specifically enumerated attribute values) into corresponding CSS styles, used within an HTML purifier library for sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_EnumToCSS
